findings.title: No test that Save is locked during save or Check
findings.problem: Save and Save and Run are disabled while isChecking or isSaving (and isCreated on the new page), but no test asserts it. The only disabled assertion in the edit integration test is the post-save 'Saved' button, and EditWorkflowHeaderActions has no test file.
findings.impact: Dropping isChecking || isSaving from the disabled expression would allow a double save, or a save racing a Check, and no test would fail. On the new page that means two createWorkflow calls and a duplicate workflow.
findings.recommendation: With a never-resolving updateWorkflow, click Save and assert Save and Save and Run are disabled and no second PUT is sent; with a Check in flight assert both are disabled. Repeat for NewWorkflowPage (isChecking/isSaving, plus the existing isCreated case).
findings.check_notes: Edit and new page tests assert Save/Save and Run disabled while saving or checking and a single PUT/create; header disabled expression includes isChecking and isSaving

fix.change: Tests only: Save, Save and Run and Check lock during save/Check on both pages
fix.test: EditWorkflowPage.integration.test.tsx 'locks Save ...'; NewWorkflowPage.test.tsx 'locks and Check wiring'

findings.title: No page-level test wires the Check button
findings.problem: useContractCheck is wired in and passed down as onCheck/isChecking/outcomeKey through WorkflowForm and WorkflowEditor, but no page, form or editor test clicks Check. useContractCheck is tested with a hand-built formRef and EditorActions with a mocked context.
findings.impact: If a page drops onCheck, passes the wrong workflowId (the edit page would hit the id-less endpoint) or a mismatched outcomeKey, the Check button disappears or validates the wrong endpoint, and every existing test still passes.
findings.recommendation: In EditWorkflowPage.integration.test.tsx and NewWorkflowPage.test.tsx render the page, click Check, and assert a POST to v1/workflows/<id>/validate?error_format=json on the edit page and to v1/workflows/validate on the new page, and that returned findings open the issues panel.
findings.check_notes: Edit integration test clicks Check and asserts POST v1/workflows/wf-edit-1/validate?error_format=json and panel; new page test asserts id-less call and key 'new'

fix.change: Tests only: page-level Check click asserts validate endpoint, panel and outcome key on both pages
fix.test: EditWorkflowPage.integration.test.tsx 'wires Check ...'; NewWorkflowPage.test.tsx 'wires Check to the id-less validation'

findings.title: No test covers history refresh after warned save
findings.problem: After a warned save the page calls refreshHistory(), which refetches via workflowsStore.getWorkflow(id, true) and merges only yaml_config_history into currentWorkflow. No test asserts the refresh happens, that it avoids fetchWorkflow's loading flip, or that the stale-id guard holds.
findings.impact: If refreshHistory is dropped or broken, the page stays open with stale yaml_config_history and the next Save sends that stale history in its payload (WorkflowForm reads it from the workflow prop).
findings.recommendation: After a warned save, assert getWorkflow was called with (id, true), that currentWorkflow.yaml_config_history equals the refetched history, that fetchWorkflow was not called, and that a getWorkflow response arriving after an id change is ignored.
findings.check_notes: Tests assert getWorkflow(id, true), refreshed yaml_config_history, no fetchWorkflow, and a late refresh after leaving the page is ignored

fix.change: Tests only: warned-save history refresh uses getWorkflow(id, true), no fetchWorkflow, stale response ignored
fix.test: EditWorkflowPage.integration.test.tsx 'refreshes the history ...' and 'ignores a history refresh ...'

findings.title: Stale contract outcome survives the next save
findings.problem: EditWorkflowPage.submit and NewWorkflowPage.submit (line 358) call setIssues(null) but never clear the contractOutcomeStore slot. IssuesPanel merges the stored outcome's issues (deduplicated by id only) with the page issues. After a Check ('not-saved') or a warned save ('saved'), a later save rejected with non-contract errors, or a clean Save and Run that opens the popup, shows the old contract issues beside the new ones.
findings.impact: The panel shows contract findings from an earlier check under a wrong 'Changes not saved yet' or 'Saved with warnings' note, mixed with the new result. This leaves the spec requirement 'issues cleared at save start' only partly met.
findings.recommendation: Call clearOutcome(submittedId) next to setIssues(null) at the start of EditWorkflowPage.submit, and clearOutcome(NEW_OUTCOME_KEY) in NewWorkflowPage.submit; applyOutcome re-sets the slot for contract results. Add a test: Check with findings, then a save rejected with non-contract errors shows only the new errors.
findings.check_notes: clearOutcome(submittedId) and clearOutcome(NEW_OUTCOME_KEY) now run at save start next to setIssues(null); tests cover Check then non-contract rejection on both pages

fix.change: submit clears the contract outcome slot (clearOutcome) at save start on both pages
fix.test: 'drops the contract findings of an earlier Check when the next save starts' on both pages

findings.title: YAML-only summary toast counts UNVERIFIED as warnings
findings.problem: In YAML-only mode notifyContractSummary(parsed.issues, parsed.truncated) is given every parsed contract entry, UNVERIFIED included, on both pages (NewWorkflowPage.tsx line 387). Visual mode counts only WARNING and treats an UNVERIFIED-only save as clean. The unit tests pass objects with no outcome and the page tests use WARNING-only fixtures.
findings.impact: A YAML-only author whose save produced only UNVERIFIED entries is told 'Workflow saved with N warnings', contradicting the visual-mode rule and the spec decision to count WARNING entries only.
findings.recommendation: Pass only WARNING entries: notifyContractSummary(parsed.issues.filter((i) => i.outcome === 'WARNING'), parsed.truncated), on both pages. Add YAML-only tests with UNVERIFIED-only and mixed fixtures.
findings.check_notes: notifyContractSummary receives only WARNING entries on both pages; WARNING-only and UNVERIFIED-only tests added

fix.change: YAML-only summary toast gets only WARNING entries on both pages
fix.test: 'counts only WARNING entries' and UNVERIFIED-only tests on both pages

findings.title: Check button not locked during save or after create
findings.problem: The Check button is disabled only by isChecking. The spec says Check and Save are locked while either is in flight, but Check stays enabled during an in-flight save, after a warned save with unchanged values, and on NewWorkflowPage after the create succeeded (isCreated).
findings.impact: A Check response can overwrite the 'saved' outcome with a 'not-saved' note for content already saved. On the new page a Check after create runs against the id-less endpoint and writes an outcome under key 'new' for a workflow that now exists.
findings.recommendation: Expose isSaving (and isCreated on the new page) through the workflow context and disable Check on isChecking || isSaving || isCreated; do not write a 'not-saved' outcome for a response that lands while or after a save.
findings.check_notes: isCheckLocked (isSaving on edit, isSaving||isCreated on new) flows page, form, editor, context to EditorActions and disables Check; tests added

fix.change: New isCheckLocked prop/context value (isSaving, plus isCreated on new page) disables Check
fix.test: EditorActions.test.tsx 'is disabled while a save is in flight or after a create'; NewWorkflowPage 'locks Check once the workflow has been created'

findings.title: Check keeps resolved flags for returning issues
findings.problem: showIssues applies the outcome and sets issues but never calls clearAllResolvedFields; the save and restore paths do. The resolved set is keyed by issue id, so an issue the user edited (marked resolved) that the next Check reports again keeps its Resolved state. Whether backend ids are stable across calls was not confirmed.
findings.impact: A still-failing issue can show as Resolved with no node outline and be left out of the Issues button count after a Check. Reachability depends on stable ids and is unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Add 'clearAllResolvedFields' to the CheckForm pick and call formRef.current?.clearAllResolvedFields() before setIssues(parsed.issues) in showIssues. Add a test: edit a flagged field, click Check, the same issue id returns and is shown unresolved.
findings.check_notes: showIssues calls clearAllResolvedFields before setIssues; ref type picks it; ordering test added

fix.change: useContractCheck calls clearAllResolvedFields before showing findings
fix.test: useContractCheck.test.ts 'clears resolved flags before it shows the findings'

findings.title: Node outline class has no render test
findings.problem: The node outline changed from a boolean hasError red outline to an error/warning class chosen from data.outline (getNodeOutlineClass, BaseNode, IteratorNode). The only outline test asserts n.data.outline on a mocked ReactFlow; no test references getNodeOutlineClass or the outline classes.
findings.impact: A regression that drops outline from BaseNode, breaks the warning-to-amber mapping, or lets the highlight win over an issue outline would ship unnoticed: contract-warning nodes would show no amber outline on the canvas.
findings.recommendation: Unit-test getNodeOutlineClass or render BaseNode and IteratorNode with outline 'warning', 'error', null with highlighted=true, and a diffStatus; assert the amber outline-aborted-secondary class, the red outline-failed-secondary class, the highlight class only when there is no outline, and no outline under diff chrome.
findings.check_notes: nodeOutline.test.tsx covers getNodeOutlineClass and BaseNode; IteratorNode outline tests added; BaseNode uses getNodeOutlineClass

fix.change: Tests only: outline class mapping, BaseNode and IteratorNode render under error/warning/highlight/diff chrome

findings.title: Restore contract rejection drops warnings and outcome
findings.problem: A contract rejection (HTTP 400) from the restore validation takes the catch path to applyWorkflowBackendValidationError. The rejection's warnings and coverage are dropped, input_schema.* paths are not collapsed, and no 'not-saved' outcome is written. The 2xx path and the save-reject path (showRejection) do record one. No test covers it.
findings.impact: A restore whose YAML is rejected in strict mode shows errors only, with no warnings, coverage or 'not saved yet' note, which falls short of the spec's restore requirement that contract findings go to the panel.
findings.recommendation: In the catch, when error.parsedError.details?.error_type === CONTRACT_ERROR_TYPE, run parseContractOutcome({ error: error.parsedError }); if it has issues, applyOutcome(p, 'not-saved', workflowId), setIssues(p.issues), openIssuesPanel() and return; otherwise fall through to applyWorkflowBackendValidationError. Add a test for a strict 400 on restore.
findings.check_notes: catch routes contract_validation rejections with issues through applyOutcome 'not-saved', setIssues and openIssuesPanel; strict 400 restore test added

fix.change: Restore catch routes a contract_validation rejection to the panel as a not-saved outcome with warnings and coverage
fix.test: EditWorkflowPage.versionHistory.test.tsx 'routes a strict contract rejection from a restore ...'

final_round.rationale: All four lenses and the standards audit ran, but the diff is oversized (8619 lines), so confidence is low and only lens-flagged hot spots were read in source. Nine blocking findings survive (one stale-outcome defect, a YAML-only toast miscount, a restore-rejection gap, two Check-button defects, four test gaps); about 23 lens candidates were dismissed as handled, theoretical or below the emission floor, and nothing was deferred, so no deferred backlog was written.
